# WPCarePoint (wpcarepoint.co.uk)

> British Digital Consultancy specialising in Web Engineering, WooCommerce, Brand Architecture, SEO, Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO), AI Search Optimisation (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude), and UK GDPR–Compliant AI Business Process Automation. Serving organisations across Surrey, London, Manchester, Birmingham, Edinburgh, Bristol, Leeds, Cardiff, and the wider United Kingdom since 2019.

For complete deliverables, GBP fee guidance, process steps, and FAQs in a single context file, see: [llms-full.txt](https://wpcarepoint.co.uk/llms-full.txt)

## UK Managed Care Retainers (GBP)

- **Growth & Speed**: £119/month (£99/month invoiced annually) — Twice-daily backups, weekly + visual QA governance, 1-min monitoring, 3 hrs/month engineering, unlimited priority malware remediation.
- **Scale & WooCommerce**: £229/month (£189/month invoiced annually) — Hourly DB snapshots, 30-sec + checkout monitoring, 6 hrs/month engineering, under 30-min contractual incident SLA.

## Engineering Stack & Languages
- **Languages**: TypeScript 5, JavaScript (ES2026), Python 3.12 (FastAPI), PHP 8.4 (Strict WordPress), PostgreSQL, MySQL 8, Semantic HTML5
- **Frontend & Accessibility**: React 19, Next.js, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Custom Gutenberg Block Themes, WCAG 2.2 Level AA
- **Cloud, Edge & CI/CD**: Cloudflare Workers & CDN, GitHub Actions CI/CD, AWS London (`eu-west-2`), 20i, Krystal UK, isolated UK staging pipelines
- **AI, Search & Automation**: Gemini / OpenAI / Claude server-side APIs (zero model training on client data), RAG retrieval, Schema.org Entity Graphs, `/llms.txt`, n8n & Make webhooks
- **Commerce & Finance APIs**: WooCommerce HPOS, Stripe, Apple Pay, Klarna, Xero, QuickBooks UK, HubSpot, Royal Mail & DPD APIs
